Title: Application Menu
Description: Here you can open a file, view help, customize settings, check for updates and more.

Title: Open a File
Description: Open designs from your computer or recent files.

Title: Add to Bed
Description: Add designs from your library or computer to the bed.

Title: Primitive Shapes
Description: Drag primitives to the bed to create your own designs.

Title: Undo & Redo
Description: Made a mistake? Undo and redo any change to your design.

Title: Tumble Cube
Description: Adjust the position of your view. You can also snap to specific views by clicking the cube.

Title: Sign In
Description: Click here to sign into your MatterHackers account.

Title: Search MatterCAD
Description: Quickly find tools, designs, and help topics.

Title: Themes
Description: Pick a color theme that suits you.

Title: Help
Description: Stuck? Find tutorials, docs, and keyboard shortcuts here.
